note: Cases built from fixtures run through `orb validate --json` (the Rust check): a deployment that places every orbital once, two units, an empty unit, an unknown orbital, an orbital placed twice, an unplaced orbital, no deployment, a single orbital and every failure at once. Units are walked in the map order (sorted keys).
